title: Première Communication relative à l'Adaptation aux Changements Climatiques au Togo
organization: Ministère de l'Environnement et des Ressources Forestières, République Togolaise
temporal_coverage: Synthesis of 2017-2023 vulnerability studies; projections to 2050 and 2100
methodology: Government communication synthesizes assessments, document review, stakeholder consultations and field visits.
limitations: Regional indices summarize cited sector studies rather than one unified underlying dataset.

title: Contributions Déterminées au Niveau National Révisées du Togo: Document Intérimaire
organization: Ministère de l'Environnement et des Ressources Forestières, République Togolaise
temporal_coverage: Historical sector impacts and climate observations; basin and sector projections to 2030 and 2050
methodology: Interim revised NDC compiles climate projections, sector vulnerability assessments and reported impacts.
limitations: Sector figures cite distinct studies and periods; climate-conflict links are not causal event analyses.

title: FAO GIEWS Country Brief on Togo
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
temporal_coverage: GIEWS reference date 28 August 2026; reports 2026 crop conditions, June 2026 flooding and the 2026 lean season.
methodology: FAO GIEWS integrates crop monitoring, food-security classification and market information.
limitations: Snapshot; seasonal outlook is not a final 2026 harvest result.

title: Response in Coastal Countries Linked to Sahel Crisis Spillover: Humanitarian Situation Report No. 2, End of Year 2024
temporal_coverage: UNICEF regional report covering 1 January to 31 December 2024; published 14 April 2025.
methodology: UNICEF regional annual situation report with country-level humanitarian needs and programme reporting.
limitations: The Togo chapter is operational and its displacement and access figures describe 2024, not current prevalence.

title: Togo Hydromet and Early Warning Services
temporal_coverage: WMO project portfolio page lists the project as completed; the accessible page does not state dates.
methodology: WMO project portfolio page lists objectives, partners and output areas.
limitations: The page lists outputs but does not report which were delivered or measure resulting forecast or warning performance.

title: Analyse du paysage climatique pour les enfants au Togo: Placer les droits des enfants au cœur de l’action climatique
organization: Ministry of Environment and Forest Resources of Togo, with support from the United Nations Children’s Fund
temporal_coverage: Publisher webpage summary for the French-language Ministry–UNICEF climate landscape for children, published November 2025.
methodology: Accessible publisher summary identifies the report authors and summarizes child-focused climate risks and policy findings.
limitations: The underlying 19 MB French report was not readable; the page summary gives national themes without local estimates or detailed methods.
